about-page.title: About
about-page.description-1: Frontend developer (React / TypeScript) with 4+ years of commercial development experience.
about-page.description-2: From 2013 to 2020, I worked as an SEO optimizer: analytics, preparing recommendations for improving websites, reporting to clients, and being responsible for the growth of traffic and positions in search results. Since 2020, I have completed professional retraining and completely switched to frontend development.
about-page.description-3: I specialize in developing SPA and PWA applications using React and TypeScript. I have experience in designing architecture (Feature-Sliced Design), participating in the development of UI kits (design systems), and optimizing performance (Core Web Vitals: LCP, CLS).
about-page.description-4: I work with REST API, WebSockets, and modern state management tools (Redux Toolkit, React Query). I refactor legacy code and reduce technical debt.
about-page.description-5: I participate in code reviews and technical interviews. I performed the functions of a technical lead: mentoring junior developers, coordinating tasks, decomposition, and participating in architectural decisions.
about-page.description-6: English language — B1: I read technical documentation and conduct basic correspondence.
